notifications.body:
Alliance announcement from Beolein (Officer)

Hallo zusammen, der KI-Offizier wurde deaktiviert und ist jetzt nur noch auf "Zerstreuen" aktiv. Er muss neu eingestellt werden. Bitte beachtet das. Wenn ihr auf Nummer sicher gehen wollt, schützt die Flotte über Nacht im grünen Sektor.

notifications.subject: Command vessel reward recovered
notifications.body: Crew member recruited: Marta Veil, "Resource Accounting" (common). They are available in Command Core > Overview.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

Now that was a real battle.

You performed exceptionally. The Ark Raider base has been destroyed, their main force broken, and our crews gained valuable combat experience. More importantly, we finally have answers.

The captured data and prisoner interrogations confirm that the pirates found the Ark in orbit around that planet. They detected no active defenses and decided to enter it.

At first, they intended to steal the entire Ark, but they could not gain control of the ship. They then began dismantling it. The work took several months. I fear they already sold or repurposed most of its resources, equipment, and technology.

The fate of the Ark's crew is worse.

The pirates took people in stasis pods and sold them through their markets. According to the records, some buyers wanted slaves. Others, as revolting as it sounds, wanted souvenirs from the era of Project Genesis.

It is difficult to believe that humanity could sink so low.

We will try to trace those transactions, but I would not expect much. The trails are old, some brokers have vanished, and some records were destroyed. Perhaps one day we will still find and rescue those caught in this madness.

There is also an important discovery for our scientists. The base retained scans of the Ark made before dismantling began. Dr. Voss believes they may help us understand what caused the original accident.

One last matter.

We will answer the pirates in kind. We will take this base apart piece by piece and use its resources to develop the colony.

At least something useful will remain after their barbarism.

notifications.subject: Varn Steelridge, Chief Engineer
notifications.body:
Commander, chief engineer here.

It looks like you found something interesting.

This ship module was built with a highly unusual technology. I suspect we are looking at a Precursor design, later modified for use aboard imperial vessels. The architecture is non-standard, the materials are rare, and the coupling principles for onboard systems go well beyond ordinary shipbuilding.

I doubt finds like this will be common, so I see little point trying to adapt the module for ordinary ships. Too much work for a single specimen.

On your vessel, however, this system may reveal its full potential. Its adaptive structure was made for integrating non-standard technologies. It will take time to install the module and align it with the primary circuits, but I am confident the result will be worth it.

In the Command Core - Overview tab, you can select the module you found and order its installation aboard the ship.

Keep your eyes open, Commander. If we can find the rarest examples of these technologies, they may significantly strengthen your vessel.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

Our drones have found the Ark raiders' base.

Ahem. Formally, they call themselves something else. According to intercepted data, the group uses the name 'Void Fiends.' Frankly, I do not care what a pack of vicious barbarians calls itself. The crew has already settled on another name: Ark Raiders. I see no reason to change it.

Reconnaissance points to a large structure built inside an asteroid. Judging by the energy signatures and external activity, this is no transfer point. We have probably found one of their main bases.

First, send drones directly to the object. We need to know exactly what forces we face, how many ships they have, how their defenses are arranged, and whether the approaches are mined.

Once we have that data, prepare a fleet suited to the threat and lead us into the attack, Commander.

Let us show these pirates that we are not to be trifled with.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, excellent work.

The raider hideout has been destroyed. We captured prisoners and recovered part of their data before they could erase it.

From what we know, these people search for and dismantle old Imperial structures. To them, Arks are merely another source of parts, technology, and people. I must admit, they behave worse than drunken soldiers dragged out of the brig.

They send dismantled components to their base. From there, the cargo is sold or used for their own purposes. Unfortunately, despite all their barbarism, they managed to erase part of the route data.

The interrogations have still produced a result. Their base must be nearby. We need to send drones to search the sector for anomalies again. Sooner or later, we will find their main trail.

We should also prepare a stronger force, Commander. The transfer point was only a forward hideout. Their base will be defended far more heavily. We will need fighters and interceptors for an operation of that scale.

There is some good news. The pirates had resource stockpiles that had not yet been shipped to the base. Send cargo ships to recover the trophies.

We have taken the first step. Now we need to find their lair.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

We found an Ark raider hideout. Reconnaissance indicates that it is a transfer point rather than their main base. That gives us an advantage: they do not yet know they have been discovered.

We need to strike before they can escape, destroy their records, or warn the others. Our objective is not simply to clear the site. We need prisoners, internal logs, supply routes, and any information about their bases.

The drone recorded only two scouts, but I would not assume that is their entire force. Pirates rarely show everything they have, especially when guarding a warehouse or communications node.

We must also account for mines. After what we saw at the Ark wreckage, I consider them a priority threat. The approach must be checked in advance and without unnecessary risk.

Five scouts accompanying your ship should be enough to identify traps, cover the flanks, and secure the operation. Any additional available ships will still be useful.

The ship is ready to attack on your order, Commander.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

The information on those whom the survivors called Ark raiders has been loaded into our databases. We compared the ship descriptions, insignia, and data fragments with what we already know about pirates in this sector.

It appears they are one of the local pirate groups.

As far as we understand, they have no unified command. We are dealing with many separate groups, each with its own ships, bases, and methods. But these raiders use distinctive markings, and our systems now know what to search for.

I recommend sweeping the nearby systems. If they dismantled the Ark, there must be a base, a warehouse, or at least a transfer point somewhere nearby. We need to find their trail.

We should not delay, Commander. They took technology, databases, and people. It may have been another Ark, but those were still our people. The people of Project Genesis.

Send drones to search the sector for anomalies. Sooner or later, we will find the raiders' trail.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

The medics have completed the first revival of the people rescued from stasis. Most are still too weak for a long conversation, but one crew member has recovered enough to give a statement.

He is the same person mentioned in the stasis capsule logs. He had awakened once before and then returned to stasis.

According to him, a malfunction in the stasis system woke him. Strangely enough, that malfunction saved his life. He came to consciousness just as other people boarded the Ark.

He managed to restore part of the data. During its flight, the Ark encountered a spatial anomaly, possibly a forming wormhole. The collision caused severe damage, and the emergency systems placed the vessel in orbit around the nearest planet suitable for colonization.

The systems could no longer wake the crew.

The survivor does not know how long the Ark remained in orbit. Other people eventually found it. He cannot identify them. They had ships and modified Imperial equipment. The Ark's defensive systems were apparently damaged as well, allowing them to enter and begin dismantling the vessel for parts.

While they were working, someone attacked them. The first group retreated and left the system. The attackers did not take the remaining sections. They simply mined the Ark and left it waiting for whoever approached next.

The survivor does not know what happened to the other stasis capsules. Some may still be in the hands of those who dismantled the Ark.

He tried to restore at least part of the systems, but almost nothing remained intact. Life support was dead, communications were silent, and the power lines were severed. He made the only choice that offered a chance of survival: he returned to stasis. The capsules have independent power supplies, and he hoped that another Ark, or perhaps the Guardians, would eventually find them.

There is one more matter. He wishes to join you, Commander.

I checked his qualifications. They are quite good. Before the accident he served aboard the Ark and has experience with ship systems. After everything that happened, he clearly wants to prove that he can still be useful. We are always looking for capable officers. You can assign him from Command Core — Crew.

I believe this may help more than just him. Such determination can inspire the rest of the crew. And we should remain alert. We need to find these Ark raiders.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting on the operation.

The detected object was indeed part of a Project Genesis Ark. More precisely, it was what remained of one. Preliminary estimates indicate that roughly one third of the original structure survived. The other sections are missing.

Marks on the hull show that the Ark did not simply break apart. It was dismantled methodically with industrial equipment or heavy demolition systems. Whoever did this knew what they were looking for and left almost nothing intact.

The approach was mined. Thanks to the scouts, we detected most of the mines in advance and minimized the damage. Without their reconnaissance, the ship could have suffered far more serious harm.

Inside the surviving compartments, the landing party found several dozen people in stasis. The capsules were damaged, but some systems were still operating. While checking the available logs, our specialists found a strange entry: one person in a stasis capsule had awakened before returning to sleep.

While the team considered its next move, explosives were discovered deep inside the Ark. The bomb was already active. It appears the timer started after some of the mines were disarmed. There was too little time for complete disposal or evacuation of the entire object.

I ordered the crew to transfer as many survivors as possible to our ship.

The evacuation ended at the final second. The ship reached a safe distance before the explosion, but the remains of the Ark were almost completely destroyed.

Whoever arranged this did more than dismantle the Ark. They left a trap to erase the evidence and kill anyone who tried to investigate it.

The rescued people are already being brought out of stasis. The medics are proceeding carefully. Many are in serious but stable condition. When they wake, perhaps one of them can explain what happened to the Ark.

I will keep you informed, Commander.

notifications.subject: Kael'thos, Pathfinder
notifications.body:
Commander, Chief Scout Kael'thos reporting.

The drone has returned from the system where the Ark hull fragment was found. Its data confirms that the discovery was not accidental.

A signature from a large artificial object was detected in orbit around one of the planets. Its mass, contours, and residual energy trace suggest that it may be the Ark we are looking for.

We cannot yet tell whether anyone is aboard. The signal is unstable, interference is heavy, and the object's hull, if it truly is an Ark, partially shields its internal compartments. We will need a direct inspection.

With our military forces still limited, this is an appropriate task for your ship, Commander. It is autonomous enough to conduct reconnaissance and strong enough to handle unexpected complications.

I still advise taking a pair of scouts. They can perform advance reconnaissance, check the approaches, and assist in combat if it comes to that.

When you are ready, proceed to the detected anomaly.

notifications.subject: Dr. Elara Voss, Chief Scientist
notifications.body:
Commander, Dr. Voss reporting.

The fragment analysis is complete. I must admit, this is a highly unusual find.

At first we thought it was ordinary wreckage from an old ship embedded in metallic rock. After cleaning the surface and performing spectral analysis, however, we found part of a serial number. The marking is badly damaged, but enough remains for a preliminary conclusion.

It appears to be a hull fragment from one of the Project Genesis Arks.

Unfortunately, we cannot determine which Ark it belonged to. The serial sequence is too badly damaged. But damage of this kind means that something happened to that Ark. I would not draw premature conclusions, but I believe we should look for other traces.

Our improved anomaly-search drones are exactly what we need here. As soon as possible, send drones to inspect the system where the fragment was found. If other fragments, energy traces, or signs of an old accident remain there, our scanners should detect them.

One more thing: the hull fragment has given us all the information it can, so I passed it to the engineers. They can recycle it for use in the colony.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

The escort mission is complete. The ship performed exceptionally well. Every maneuver was executed without deviation, the combat drills succeeded, and coordination with the mining vessels proceeded normally.

The crew is gradually adapting to the new environment. They still treat Guardian systems with caution, but they are beginning to understand how to work with them. That is a good sign. The more practical experience we give the crew, the more confidently they will act in a real operation.

We also found something interesting during the run. One of the miners recovered an object that was initially mistaken for a fragment of a metallic asteroid. After a preliminary inspection, the crew reported that a piece of starship hull was embedded inside the rock.

Its origin is unknown. It may be ordinary wreckage, but considering where we found it, I would not dismiss it.

We should give the fragment to our scientists. They may be able to extract useful information from it.

notifications.subject: Zik'nara, War Commander
notifications.body:
Commander, Colony G43-35-P2 is outside the Wardens' protection zone.

We must build the planet's defenses ourselves. Enemy fleets can reach this colony. An undefended frontier world is an invitation to our enemies.

Build a Shield Generator as soon as the colony has the resources. A shield will not make the planet invulnerable, but it will provide initial protection and allow safer recovery after an attack.

Do not forget the other defensive measures. Combat defense systems can strike ships in planetary orbit and shoot down assault shuttles. A ground-force garrison will resist those who manage to reach the surface. Concealing our stockpiles and deploying trap systems will slow enemies in their attempts to steal our resources.

Do not delay defense construction. It is better to prepare in advance than to hope the enemy is slow.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

Since improving the ship requires more practical sorties, I recommend we do not delay. We have several mining freighters available. We should escort them on their next run.

This will let the crew practice standard escort patterns, convoy formation, and interaction with other ships. At the same time, we can use asteroids as targets and run a safe weapons drill.

The chance of hostile contact is low. But even if someone tries to test our readiness, you need not worry about the ship. The pilots found that its control program has retreat directives hard-wired in case of destruction risk.

Ahem. It appears that even under direct order, we cannot send this vessel into a suicidal attack. Apparently the Guardians studied our military history and ruled that possibility out completely.

One more thing. The ship should have a name. I am not superstitious, but the crew will be calmer flying aboard a named ship rather than an unnamed Guardian vessel.

As soon as the freighters are ready for their next run, we should join them, Commander.

notifications.subject: Dr. Elara Voss, Chief Scientist
notifications.body:
Commander, Dr. Elara Voss reporting.

I have prepared a report on the state of your connection to the Guardian ship. I cannot judge your sensations, but during the flight you may have noticed a small delay between a direct command and the system response.

The cause is our infrastructure. Current equipment cannot support your connection to the ship at the required level. For deeper synchronization, we will need much more powerful computing centers.

I have already made the necessary changes to our laboratory projects. This will not require additional resources, but the maximum available level of your synchronization with the ship will depend on laboratory level.

There is a second factor. Your digital consciousness must adapt to controlling a system this complex. The solution here is simpler: interact with the ship more often. The more sorties you fly and the more directly you command its systems, the faster synchronization will improve.

We have also found another way to accelerate the process. Part of our laboratory research will be performed using the ship's computational systems. This will help our algorithms interact with Guardian technology more effectively while improving the quality of your connection to it.

I hope that explanation was not too dull. In short: laboratory level defines the maximum synchronization level, while the current value rises through ship sorties and laboratory research.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander, reporting.

The first test flight completed successfully. Thrust, navigation, weapons, and the power system are operating within expected parameters. No faults detected.

The crew is gradually learning Guardian equipment. The ship's technologies differ sharply from everything our specialists are used to, so we should not expect exceptional results after a single flight. They will need time, practice, and strict training. I will make sure the training proceeds without undue haste or violations of protocol.

Dr. Voss asked to contact you. From her wording, it concerns your direct connection to the ship and the data collected during the flight.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body:
Commander. Executive Officer Garrett Tane reporting for duty.

I am a career fleet officer. I served aboard combat and expedition vessels, commanded crews on long deployments, and I am used to relying on regulations, discipline, and a clear chain of command.

I will be direct: serving under a digital mind is unfamiliar to me. My previous captains stood on the bridge beside the crew, sharing every success and hardship, and that is the order I know. But you are the commander of this ship, and my doubts will not interfere with carrying out your orders.

I will take direct charge of the crew, monitor the ship's condition, and execute your commands. I will also report problems and offer recommendations when I consider them necessary. I do not promise to tell you what you want to hear, but I do promise to tell you the truth.

The ship's primary systems are ready for their first trial. I recommend a safe flight inside the system. We need to check thrust, navigation, power, communications, and the response of modular systems in open space.

The ship is ready to launch. Give the order from the Overview tab.

notifications.subject: Science Team, Guardian Ship
notifications.body:
The link to the Guardian ship is configured. All control circuits are checked and protection protocols are active.

Do not worry. We will monitor every indicator: stability of your digital consciousness, core response, channel load, and any deviation during synchronization.

I cannot imagine what a direct connection to a system like this will feel like, but I know you can handle it.

The ship is waiting for you, Commander. We begin on your order.

notifications.subject: Science Team, Guardian Ship
notifications.body:
Commander, this is incredible.

The science team has completed a deeper study of the Guardian ship. The results are astonishing. I try to avoid grand language in reports, but in this case it is difficult to find any other words.

The ship's technology is extraordinary. Its internal systems can adapt to different equipment, interfaces, and energy circuits. The structure also allows modifications without standard shipyard reconstruction.

We have named this a modular system. Our engineers have proposed similar concepts before, but every project was rejected as too complex. The Guardians did not simply solve that problem. They made it the foundation of the ship.

And there is more. We found the activation method.

The ship requires you, Commander. Its central system will activate only after a direct connection to your digital consciousness. As far as we can tell, the procedure should be safe. The ship is not trying to overwrite or restrict your personality. Its architecture looks as if it is waiting for a command mind capable of becoming part of the control system.

If the connection succeeds, it will give you new options. The ship's unique systems can expand your coordination, analysis, and command capacity, helping the colony reach beyond our current expectations.

On your order, we will configure the channel for connecting your digital mind to the Guardian ship.

notifications.subject: Scout Group, Guardian Ship
notifications.body:
Commander. The scout group has completed the first inspection. Confirmed: this is a ship. Not a capsule, not an automated module, and not an orbital platform. A full vessel.

More importantly, its internal layout is clearly built for humans: living sections, corridors, command posts, emergency paths, and maintenance access. Everything is arranged so a crew can remain aboard for an extended period. That is unusual for Guardian technology, but the conclusion is clear: the ship was built so we can use it.

There is one problem. Even if the vessel is meant for us, its systems are highly non-standard. Energy circuits, control interfaces, and internal architecture do not match Imperial designs or ordinary Project Genesis ship protocols. We still do not know how to activate its primary systems.

To command a ship like this, we need the best of the best. Not just a crew, but specialists able to work with an unknown machine in real time.

I recommend sending an expanded team aboard: experienced pilots, engineers, and scientists. They can assess the ship, study its systems, and attempt to learn how to bring it online.

If the Guardians really left this ship for us, we need to understand exactly what we have received.

notifications.subject: Garrett Tane, Executive Officer
notifications.body: The recovered cargo and pirate archives have been analyzed. Records show that roughly ten of our people were sold on neutral ground. We have hull marks, communication fragments, and route signatures. Send survey drones through nearby systems; if those ships remain close, we will find their trail.

notifications.subject: Zik'nara, War Commander
notifications.body:
Commander. Zik'nara online. Urgent message.

System sensors have detected a Guardian convoy. Several objects entered our system and are moving toward the planet. Their trajectory, speed, and formation indicate deliberate movement toward us. This does not match ordinary Guardian patrol behavior.

I am raising orbital observation protocols. Even with how little we understand Guardian motives, I do not recommend treating this as a routine visit.

One moment, Commander... Report... What?.. Commander, new data.

The convoy has stopped in high orbit. One object separated from formation. The remaining ships have turned away and are leaving the system on the same vector they used to arrive.

The Guardians left an unusual ship in orbit. It is not answering standard hails, it is transmitting no threats, and it is not approaching our assets. We received no explanation, terms, or warning.

Their motives remain unknown, but the gesture looks intentional. They delivered the ship to our planet, left it within reach, and departed. Most likely, this object is meant for us.

Requesting permission to send a scout group. We need to inspect the ship, check its systems, and understand what the Guardians left in our orbit.

notifications.subject: Varn Steelridge, Chief Engineer
notifications.body:
Commander, Varn Steelridge reporting.

Outpost Engineering technology has been restored. Our shipyards can now build repair ships for servicing vessels and stations in deep space, and engineer ships capable of deploying into mining outposts.

An outpost can be placed in an asteroid belt. It will passively extract resources, not as quickly as a dedicated mining fleet, but its real value is different: it creates a remote supply and mining base far from our colonies.

A small fleet can be stationed at an outpost. These ships can launch mining runs into nearby systems without returning to the main planet every time. The outpost also helps repel pirate attacks in the belt where it is deployed.

Outposts can be upgraded. Extra cargo bays increase storage, defensive modules improve survivability, and expanded docks provide more room for stationed ships.

There is one limitation. If the asteroid belt under the outpost is depleted, its efficiency drops sharply. In that case, deliver fuel and move the outpost to a new, undepleted belt. Outposts are managed from the Mining tab.

My recommendation: place outposts where they can support mining across several nearby systems. With the right position, they become excellent forward bases for remote resource expansion.

notifications.subject: Dr. Elara Voss, Chief Scientist
notifications.body:
Commander, the freighters have returned with full holds. The asteroid lodged in the outpost was rich in ore and silicates, so the dismantling operation benefited the colony more than we expected.

The team also inspected the reactor compartment. The cause of the interference is clearer now. Someone had attempted to modify the reactor using unconventional and extremely dangerous methods. The damage indicates that the outpost was attacked. During the battle, the reactor overloaded and exploded, knocking the station out of its stable orbit.

The outpost then probably drifted away from the system for centuries. The asteroid embedded in its hull was a coincidence. A fortunate one for us, but a coincidence nonetheless.

The engineers neutralized the reactor. It will no longer interfere with our probes or obstruct reconnaissance of nearby space.

You handled this admirably, Commander. The colony gained resources, and the science department gained answers. Keep it up.

notifications.subject: Dr. Elara Voss, Chief Scientist
notifications.body:
Commander, the drone has returned and transmitted its findings. The signal source is an old mining outpost.

The imagery indicates that the facility survived a collision with a small asteroid. The fragment is still embedded in the hull. There is other damage that resembles battle scars more than the result of an accident. Parts of the outer plating were also deliberately altered after construction. Someone modified the outpost.

The interference did not come from a transmitter, but from an unusual reactor trace. Its characteristics do not match the archived specifications for facilities of this type. The outpost may have been used as a hideout, a temporary base, or a transfer point. The drone found no signs of life. Whoever was here left a very long time ago.

This place may be connected to the unidentified ships whose signals we detected earlier. We do not yet have enough evidence, but the coincidence is too conspicuous to ignore.

There is also a practical benefit. The scan shows that the outpost can be partially dismantled. Its hull, old equipment, and internal sections can be recovered as resources for the colony.

Once the restored freighters have returned from mining, we should send them to dismantle the outpost.

definition.name: Silicate Mine
definition.description: Mines crystalline formations. Essential for advanced technologies.

definition.name: Solar Plant
definition.description: Generates energy from the local star. Base power source for all planetary operations.

definition.name: Logistics Hub
definition.description: Automated logistics center. Each level enables one additional auto-delivery route from this planet.

definition.name: AA Turret
definition.description: Anti-air defense turret. Intercepts incoming assault shuttles during ground raids.

definition.name: Garrison
definition.description: Houses ground defense troops. Repels enemy raiding parties during ground assaults.

definition.name: Dyson Sphere
definition.description: A stellar-scale energy collector enveloping the star. Produces immense power without fuel.

definition.name: Molecular Assembler
definition.description: Atomic-scale fabrication facility. Converts raw matter into alloys at unprecedented rates.

definition.name: Quantum Nexus
definition.description: Quantum-entangled computing network spanning all colonies. Massively accelerates research and construction across the empire.

definition.name: Rare Resource Extractor
definition.description: Specialized facility that extracts exotic materials based on planet type. Requires advanced research.

definition.name: Quantum Synthesizer
definition.description: Harnesses quantum vacuum fluctuations to passively synthesize quantum dust. Only operational in Dead Space and Rift space where dimensional barriers are weakest.

definition.name: Storage Cloaking
definition.description: Camouflages resource storages. Increases time raiders need to locate your resources (+30s per level).

definition.name: Bio Complex
definition.description: Advanced hydroponics and life support. Produces bio-extract and accelerates population growth. On Terra worlds output is doubled (+100%) — the primary source of food and population growth.

definition.name: Construction Yard
definition.description: Automated construction facility. Reduces building upgrade time by 5% per level.

definition.name: Orbital Shipyard
definition.description: Large orbital construction facility for heavy warships. Required for building large vessels like battleships and carriers.

definition.name: Cultural Center
definition.description: Arts and cultural hub. Attracts settlers and boosts population growth.

definition.name: Medical Bay
definition.description: Advanced medical facility. Increases population growth rate and colony morale.

definition.name: Trade Hub
definition.description: Alliance trade coordination center. Enables commission-free Alliance Market trading for your alliance while at least one member has a Trade Hub. Lv.1 provides 50 active alliance trade order slots. Each additional level adds +10 alliance trade order slots. Does not affect public Trade Hub market commission.

definition.name: Shield Generator
definition.description: Generates a protective energy shield around the planet. Never fully disabled — always provides minimum protection.

definition.name: Defense Traps
definition.description: Hidden traps around key installations. Deals damage to raiding parties and slows their operations (+10s per level).

definition.name: Diplomatic Embassy
definition.description: Interstellar embassy. +2 personal pact slots per level. Alliance capacity starts at 30 members. Completed Embassy levels across alliance members unlock extra slots: the first 5 require 15 total levels each; after that, each next slot costs 1 more total level than the previous one. Maximum: 60 members.

definition.name: Fusion Reactor
definition.description: High-output energy generator that consumes hydrogen as fuel. Very efficient power source.

definition.name: Storage Complex
definition.description: Unified storage facility for all resources. Every 5 levels adds +5,000 rare resource storage.

definition.name: Zero-Point Generator
definition.description: Harnesses quantum vacuum fluctuations for nearly limitless energy. No fuel required.

definition.name: Missile Defense System
definition.description: Network of guided missile launchers. Rapid fire vs probe (x5), spy probe (x5), scout (x4), fighter (x3), interceptor (x2), assault shuttle (x2). Anti-recon screen — strength is in RF, not raw stats.

definition.name: Laser Defense System
definition.description: Concentrated laser arrays that engage orbital targets. Balanced effectiveness across armor types. Rapid fire vs freighter (x4), bulk carrier (x4), ore freighter (x4), tanker (x3), hacker ship (x3). Universal early-game generalist.

definition.name: Railgun Defense System
definition.description: Electromagnetic mass drivers firing hypersonic slugs. Rapid fire vs cruiser (x5), missile cruiser (x3), bomber (x2). Anti-medium specialist.

definition.name: Plasma Defense System
definition.description: Superheated plasma emitters that melt heavy hulls. Rapid fire vs battleship (x4), carrier (x2), dreadnought (x2), titan (x2). Late-game anti-capital anchor.

definition.name: Ion Defense System
definition.description: Ion beam emitters that overload enemy shielding. Strong vs shielded heavies. No rapid fire — relies on weapon-armor matchup.

definition.name: Electronic Warfare System
definition.description: Jamming arrays and ECM suites. Reduce enemy fleet accuracy by 3% per level (max 30%). Does not fire directly — pairs with hard-hitting defenses.

definition.name: Terraforming Station
definition.description: Reshapes planetary environment. Adds 1 building slot per level. Massive energy drain.

definition.name: Planetary Shipyard
definition.description: Constructs and maintains small spacecraft. Higher levels unlock more ship types.

definition.name: Residential Complex
definition.description: Provides housing for population. Higher population enables more efficient operations. Also boosts population growth rate.

definition.name: Alloy Foundry
definition.description: Smelts ore and silicates into advanced alloys. Required for ships and advanced buildings.

definition.name: Thermal Plant
definition.description: Extracts geothermal energy. Expensive to build, but increasingly efficient at higher levels.

definition.name: Ore Mine
definition.description: Extracts ore from planetary deposits. Higher levels increase extraction rate.

definition.name: Hydrogen Processor
definition.description: Extracts and processes hydrogen from the atmosphere. Used for fuel and alloy synthesis.

definition.name: Research Lab
definition.description: Conducts scientific research. Higher levels unlock advanced technologies.

definition.name: Probe
definition.description: Unmanned recon drone. Fastest ship, minimal spy power. Fragile — rapid-fire target for fighters.

definition.name: Spy Probe
definition.description: Stealth recon drone. Higher spy power than probe. Requires Signal Intelligence research.

definition.name: Scout
definition.description: Fast light warship. Good for patrols and early fleet defense. Rapid-fire target for interceptors.

definition.name: Cruiser
definition.description: Heavy warship with laser weapons. Rapid fire ×5 vs fighters. Mainstay of serious fleets.

definition.name: Tanker
definition.description: Hydrogen-only transport (900 capacity). Carries fuel to extend fleet range. Cannot carry ore/silicates/alloys.

definition.name: Bulk Carrier
definition.description: Massive cargo hauler (3000 capacity). Slow but enormous capacity for large-scale transport.

definition.name: Mining Vessel
definition.description: Dedicated mining vessel. Ore: 50/cycle, Plasma: 25/cycle. Mining cargo: 300.

definition.name: Excavator
definition.description: Heavy mining platform. +20% yield bonus to entire fleet. Mines ore/ice/gas/plasma/bio fields. Mining cargo: 500. Requires Orbital Shipyard 3.

ships.name: Probe
ships.description: Unmanned recon drone. Fastest ship, minimal spy power. Fragile — rapid-fire target for fighters.

ships.name: Spy Probe
ships.description: Stealth recon drone. Higher spy power than probe. Requires Signal Intelligence research.

ships.name: Stealth Ship
ships.description: Cloaked vessel with top spy power (5). Sweeps enemy minefields (10 mines/cycle). Used for Dead Zone expeditions. Cargo: 50.

ships.name: Scout
ships.description: Fast light warship. Good for patrols and early fleet defense. Rapid-fire target for interceptors.

ships.name: Fighter
ships.description: Core combat craft. Carrier hangar buff: +25% ATK and 15% dodge (16 per carrier). Backbone of mid-game fleets.

ships.name: Interceptor
ships.description: Fast attack craft. Rapid fire ×5 vs fighters and probes. Anti-fighter specialist.

ships.name: Cruiser
ships.description: Heavy warship with laser weapons. Rapid fire ×5 vs fighters. Mainstay of serious fleets.

ships.name: Torpedo Frigate
ships.description: Small torpedo boat designed to swarm capital ships. Rapid fire ×3 vs battleships, ×2 vs dreadnoughts. Glass cannon — fast but fragile.

ships.name: Carrier
ships.description: Mobile hangar platform. Buffs 16 fighters (+25% ATK, 15% dodge), 4 bombers (+30% HP), or 4 shuttles (AA immunity). Assign role before battle. Cargo: 3000. Can transport 150 population.

ships.name: Battleship
ships.description: Capital warship with plasma weapons. Rapid fire ×4 vs cruisers. Requires Orbital Dock Lv.5.

ships.name: Missile Cruiser
ships.description: Guided missile platform. Rapid fire vs fighters (×5), interceptors (×4), bombers (×3). Area damage specialist.

ships.name: Bomber
ships.description: Anti-structure craft. Rapid fire ×5 vs defense buildings. Carrier buff: +30% HP (4 per carrier). Requires Bomber Wing research.

ships.name: Dreadnought
ships.description: Super-capital warship with ion weapons. Rapid fire vs battleships, cruisers, bombers, fighters, carriers. Built in Moon Dockyard.

ships.name: Titan
ships.description: Ultimate flagship. Rapid fire vs everything. 5000 ATK. Built in Moon Dockyard.

ships.name: Assault Shuttle
ships.description: Armored dropship for planetary raids. 50 assault power each. Vulnerable to AA turrets (2% loss/level). Carrier hangar protects from AA.

ships.name: Hacker Ship
ships.description: Electronic warfare vessel. Cracks encrypted storage during raids (30s per unit). Used for cyber attacks and Dead Zone expeditions.

ships.name: Colony Ship
ships.description: Colonization vessel. Consumed on use to settle a new planet. Can also transport 50 population on transfer/deliver missions. Population cost: 50.

ships.name: Engineer Ship
ships.description: Construction vessel. Builds outposts on asteroid fields. Consumed during construction. Full outpost cost included in ship price.

ships.name: Electronic Warfare Ship
ships.description: Electromagnetic jammer. Disrupts enemy targeting systems, reducing incoming damage. More ships improve the effect, but each additional ship contributes less. Jamming intensity fluctuates each round.

ships.name: Mine Layer
ships.description: Deploys space mines (5 per ship consumed). Mines deal 150 HP each. Max mines = 10 × Mine Warfare level per planet.

ships.name: Freighter
ships.description: Standard cargo vessel (500 capacity). Can mine ore fields when Basic Mining research is completed (15 ore/cycle).

ships.name: Transport Shuttle
ships.description: Transport shuttle fitted for raid extraction. Peaceful navigation equipment dramatically reduces its usable cargo space.

ships.name: Tanker
ships.description: Hydrogen-only transport (900 capacity). Carries fuel to extend fleet range. Cannot carry ore/silicates/alloys.

ships.name: Bulk Carrier
ships.description: Massive cargo hauler (3000 capacity). Slow but enormous capacity for large-scale transport.

ships.name: Ore Freighter
ships.description: Specialized hauler for ore and silicates only (3000 capacity). Cannot carry hydrogen or alloys.

ships.name: Mining Vessel
ships.description: Dedicated mining vessel. Ore: 50/cycle, Plasma: 25/cycle. Mining cargo: 300.

ships.name: Gas Collector
ships.description: Gas and quantum dust harvester. Gas: 15/cycle, Quantum Dust: 3/cycle. Mining cargo: 400.

ships.name: Ice Drill
ships.description: Cryo-ice and dark matter extractor. Ice: 25, Dark Matter: 3 per cycle. 3% breakdown chance per cycle.

ships.name: Excavator
ships.description: Heavy mining platform. +20% yield bonus to entire fleet. Mines ore/ice/gas/plasma/bio fields. Mining cargo: 500. Requires Orbital Shipyard 3.

ships.name: Repair Ship
ships.description: Mobile repair platform for restoring damaged ships and outpost structures.

ships.name: Lunar Shuttle
ships.description: Moon colonization vessel. Consumed during moon colonization.

research.name: Genetic Adaptation
research.description: Targeted gene therapies increase population capacity and enable settling exotic worlds.

research.name: Rift Navigation
research.description: Rift navigation. Enables expeditions into the Rift. Requires scouts and combat fleet.

research.name: Lunar Operations
research.description: Enables colonization and resource extraction on moons orbiting planets.

research.name: Trade Mastery
research.description: Negotiate better terms with merchant guilds. Each level reduces market commission by 0.5% and increases total Market Hub storage capacity by 750,000. Base capacity: 2,000,000.

research.name: Combined Operations
research.description: Alliance coordination. Unlocks combined assaults — multiple alliance members attack simultaneously.

research.name: Logistics Mastery
research.description: Optimized supply chains dramatically reduce transport time.

research.name: Rare Resource Extraction
research.description: Exotic material extraction. Unlocks Ice Drill ship. +25% cryo-ice yield.

research.name: Galactic Cartography
research.description: Complete mapping of your spiral arm. All sectors within your arm become partially visible.

research.name: Deep Wormhole Navigation
research.description: Deep wormhole navigation. Grants access to Class 3-4 wormholes.

research.name: Adaptive Shields
research.description: Shields dynamically adjust frequency to reduce damage from incoming fire.

research.name: Bomber Wing Doctrine
research.description: Anti-structure bombing tactics. Unlocks Bomber ship — ×5 rapid fire vs defense buildings. +2% bomber damage per level.

research.name: Rare Resource Processing
research.description: Rare resource refinement. Unlocks Excavator ship (+20% fleet mining yield). +20% quantum dust and plasma core yields.

research.name: Neural Networks
research.description: Advanced AI systems dramatically boost research output and fleet coordination.

research.name: Battleship Design
research.description: Capital warship design with devastating firepower and heavy armor plating.

research.name: Ion Cannons
research.description: Ionized particle beams disable enemy ship systems and drain shields. +2% ion damage per level.

research.name: Alliance Logistics
research.description: Optimized supply lines speed up all transfers and gift missions.

research.name: Xenoarchaeology
research.description: Study ancient alien ruins on moons for unique blueprints and bonuses.

research.name: Torpedo Systems
research.description: Heavy warheads designed to cripple capital ships. +2% missile damage per level.

research.name: Advanced AI Officer
research.description: Enhanced threat analysis with smart evacuation. Auto-loads cargo during retreat.

research.name: Advanced Navigation
research.description: AI-optimized route planning and fleet coordination systems. Grants +1 patrol capacity at Lv.1.

research.name: Heavy Armor
research.description: Thick ablative plating designed for capital ship survival.

research.name: Fleet Auxiliary Systems
research.description: Dedicated support vessels for fleet maintenance and sustained operations.

research.name: Weapons Overcharge
research.description: Overclock weapon capacitors for devastating firepower at the cost of energy.

research.name: Quantum Sensors
research.description: Quantum-entangled sensors unlock spy sweeps against stealth ships, reveal fleet compositions, and alert you to temporary quantum dust and dark matter eruptions in Dead Space.

research.name: Cyberwarfare
research.description: Offensive hacking. Unlocks cyber attacks: disruption (−30% production), sabotage (−30% defense), intel gathering.

research.name: Planetary Fortress
research.description: Comprehensive planetary defense network with overlapping fields of fire. Boosts orbital defense ATK and HP.

research.name: Siege Weapons
research.description: Orbital bombardment systems optimized for destroying planetary defenses. Boosts damage against defense buildings.

research.name: Advanced Outpost Systems
research.description: Upgraded outpost modules. Raises the outpost limit from 5 to 8. Higher building levels: extractor(8), shield(5), turret(5), dock(3), storage(8).

research.name: Rogue Genesis Research
research.description: Study rogue AI patterns. Enables encountering Ancient AI in the Rift.

research.name: Advanced Governance
research.description: Sophisticated bureaucratic systems enable larger empires and better crisis management.

research.name: Grand Strategy
research.description: Supreme tactical command systems for managing large-scale fleet operations.

research.name: Dreadnought Design
research.description: Massive super-capital warship. The ultimate expression of naval firepower. Requires 9,000 free energy on the research planet.

research.name: Jump Drive
research.description: Instantaneous point-to-point teleportation. Enables Jump Gates on moons. Each level reduces jump cooldown by 10 minutes (base 60 min).

research.name: Nanofabrication
research.description: Molecular-scale assembly drastically improves construction and shipbuilding efficiency.

research.name: Zero-Point Energy
research.description: Harness quantum vacuum fluctuations for nearly limitless energy.

research.name: Lunar Expansion
research.description: Advanced lunar engineering. Increases moon colony limit to 3.

research.name: Terraforming
research.description: Reshape planetary environments to improve habitability. More worlds become viable colonies.

research.name: Galactic Exchange
research.description: Galaxy-spanning marketplace accessible from any colony.

research.name: Quantum Drive
research.description: Quantum tunneling propulsion — the fastest and most efficient drive technology.

research.name: Phase Shields
research.description: Phase-shifted shield barriers have a chance to completely negate incoming hits.

research.name: Omniscience Array
research.description: A network of quantum-entangled sensors spanning the galaxy. Full visibility of all systems.

research.name: Artificial Consciousness
research.description: Self-evolving AI dramatically reduces research time. The pinnacle of computing.

research.name: Genesis Core Hacking
research.description: Hack rogue Genesis AI cores to acquire their advanced technology.

research.name: Antimatter Warheads
research.description: Matter-antimatter annihilation weaponry — the pinnacle of destructive technology.

research.name: Lunar Mastery
research.description: Full lunar dominion. Increases moon colony limit to 5.

research.name: Supreme Command
research.description: Massively expands fleet command capacity. +5 fleet slots.

research.name: Megastructure Engineering
research.description: Galaxy-scale engineering — orbital habitats and megastructures vastly expand colonization potential.

research.name: Alliance Mastery
research.description: Peak military coordination. Boosts attack and defense across all operations.

research.name: Transcendent Artifacts
research.description: Craft legendary artifacts from ancient components — the ultimate PvE reward.

research.name: Titan Design
research.description: One-of-a-kind flagship — the most powerful vessel in existence. One per empire. Requires 12,000 free energy on the research planet.

research.name: Galactic Highway Network
research.description: Interconnected jump gate network enabling instant fleet transfer between colonies.

research.name: Alcubierre Bubble Drive
research.description: Warp the fabric of space-time around the fleet using contained antimatter. Travel at extreme speed, completely invisible to enemy sensors. Requires antimatter fuel per trip.

research.name: Nanobot Repair Systems
research.description: Self-replicating nanobots continuously repair ship damage even during combat.

research.name: Ship Mastery
research.description: Perfected hull designs and construction techniques benefit all ship classes.

research.name: Dark Matter Weapons
research.description: Exotic matter weapons that bypass all known shield technology.

research.name: CNRhK
research.description: Condensed Neutron Resonance hyperKinetic weapon. Devastates planetary defenses and outpost shields.

research.name: Arc
research.description: Endgame alliance project. Requires three alliance labs of level 15 to start. Scientists will refuse to leave the project once it begins — see the Arc panel in the Research page.
